name: Western Delta Front
description: Primary deltaic sediment deposit at western delta lobe entry. High phyllosilicate signature. Key Mars 2020 science target.
source: Goudge et al. 2017; Farley et al. 2020

name: Carbonate Deposit Alpha
description: Exposed carbonate unit in delta lobe. Highest biosignature preservation potential in Jezero.

name: Carbonate Deposit Beta
description: Secondary carbonate outcrop within delta fan.

name: Carbonate Deposit Gamma
description: Tertiary carbonate exposure at delta margin.

name: Seitah Olivine Unit A
description: Seitah formation altered olivine, southeast basin. Interacted with water. Farley et al. 2022 primary target.

name: Seitah Olivine Unit B
description: Secondary Seitah olivine exposure with alteration rind.

name: Ancient Shoreline
description: Inferred ancient shoreline of Jezero paleolake. Lacustrine sediment deposition expected.

name: Rim Phyllosilicate N
description: Phyllosilicate exposure in northern crater rim. Formed by aqueous alteration.

name: Hydrated Silica Patch
description: Hydrated silica at delta inlet. High biosignature preservation. Tier 1 priority.
